_comment: Creatures, villagers, quests and named creatures. Edit this file to change names, dialogue, rewards, monster strength and what monsters do; no recompiling needed. The game reads assets/content.json next to the program if it exists, otherwise the copy built into it. The ids (Goblin, Elder, Slay_Grishnak, ...) must match the enums in the source; each creature's 'behaviours' are tried in the order listed, and each name is a capability implemented in behaviour.odin.

npcs.name: Elder Mara
npcs.idle_line: You have done more than enough. Rest a while.

npcs.name: Tomas the smith
npcs.idle_line: The forge is hot, but I've nothing for you now.

npcs.name: Yara the hunter
npcs.idle_line: The deep places have their own laws. Learn them, or die.

npcs.name: Sister Wren
npcs.idle_line: The Light does not reach past the third depth. Carry a torch, and faith.

npcs.name: Captain Aldric
npcs.idle_line: Keep the road clear, and I'll keep the gate open.

quests.title: Slay Grishnak (depth 2)
offer: Grishnak, a goblin warlord, raids us from
the second depth. Our fields burn.
Slay him, and you'll have gold, and
the chain shirt my son once wore.
quests.reminder: Grishnak still lives. Depth 2, adventurer.
thanks: Grishnak is dead? The village owes you.
Take these, as promised.

quests.title: Bring Tomas a spiked club
offer: Ogres carry clubs studded with old iron.
Bring me one in your backpack, and I'll
reforge the nails into a proper blade.
quests.reminder: No club yet? The ogres below carry them.
thanks: Ha! Good iron under all that rust.
Here: a longsword, as promised.

quests.title: Slay Gorluk (depth 4)
offer: With Grishnak gone, Gorluk the ogre
chieftain gathers the tribes at depth 4.
End him, and songs will be sung of you.
quests.reminder: Gorluk waits at depth 4.
thanks: Gorluk is dead. The songs begin tonight.
This is all the gold we could gather.

quests.title: Bring the elder a healing potion
offer: The village stores run thin on healing potion.
If you find one down there, bring it back
and we'll see you're rewarded for it.
quests.reminder: Still need that healing potion, if you find one.
thanks: That'll do nicely, thank you.
Please, take this for your trouble.
